info.title: SynCloud API
info.description: The public SynCloud controller API. The dashboard, synctl and CI all use these endpoints (plan §5.1). Authenticate with the dashboard session cookie, a personal access token (Bearer), or a signed access-key request (SYN1-HMAC-SHA256, plan §7.1).

get.summary: Controller version and setup state
This API description

post.summary: Exchange the one-time setup token for the root account and sign in

201.description: Root account created; session cookie set

post.summary: Sign in to the dashboard (sets the session cookie)
End the current session

get.summary: The authenticated user
Live event stream (WebSocket upgrade). Each message is a JSON Event.
Your access keys

post.summary: Create an access key (max 2 per user). The secret is returned only once.

delete.summary: Delete one of your access keys

get.summary: Your personal access tokens

post.summary: Create a personal access token. The token is returned only once.

delete.summary: Delete one of your personal access tokens

post.summary: Register a node with a join token (used by syncloud-agent join). Returns the node's client certificate signed from its CSR.

get.summary: All nodes with live status and latest metrics

delete.summary: Remove a node. Its certificate stops working immediately.

get.summary: Active (unexpired, unused) join tokens

post.summary: Create a join token. The token is returned only once.

get.summary: Platform components (system tasks) running on the controller node: Traefik, VictoriaMetrics, VictoriaLogs, …
Docker registry token endpoint (used by docker login/push/pull). Basic auth: access key ID + secret, or any username + personal access token.
Base domain, public IP, suggested sslip.io/nip.io domains and ACME settings

put.summary: Change the base domain. The dashboard moves to https://<domain> and the registry to registry.<domain>; certificates are requested automatically.

get.summary: TLS certificates for the platform hostnames

post.summary: Clear the retry backoff and request a certificate now

get.summary: S3 backup destination, schedule and last run

put.summary: Set the S3 destination. The bucket is checked before saving; an empty secret keeps the stored one. A first backup starts right away.

delete.summary: Turn backups off (stored backups are kept)

get.summary: Backups stored in S3, newest first

post.summary: Take a backup now

get.summary: Download a fresh encrypted backup bundle (restore needs the recovery key)
WireGuard mesh: each node's address, container subnet, endpoint and live peer links
Host firewall policies

post.summary: Create a host firewall policy. Nodes apply it with commit-confirm.

get.summary: The rules a node enforces, including built-in rules, and the rendered nftables table

put.summary: Allow or stop placing new tasks on a node (cordon/uncordon)

get.summary: Projects with their environment names

post.summary: Create a project with a first environment (default production)

get.summary: Environments of a project

post.summary: Create an environment

get.summary: Services in an environment
A service with its current spec and task counts

put.summary: Create or update a service. A changed spec becomes a new revision and is rolled out; desiredCount is optional on updates.

delete.summary: Stop all tasks and delete the service

post.summary: Set the desired task count
Roll out an earlier revision again (as a new revision)

get.summary: Active tasks and recent history
Task definition revisions, newest first
Every service in the cluster
Every active task in the cluster

post.summary: Stop a task; a replacement is started

get.summary: Stored log lines from every node, oldest first
Live tail as Server-Sent Events; each event's data is a LogLine

Interactive command in a task (WebSocket). Binary messages carry stdin/stdout; text messages carry JSON control: {"type":"resize","cols":…,"rows":…} or {"type":"eof"} from the client, {"type":"exit","code":…} or {"type":"error","message":…} from the server.
Custom domains of a service with their DNS status

post.summary: Route a custom domain to the service (HTTPS certificate requested automatically once DNS points here)

get.summary: Whether a hostname resolves to this platform, and the record to create
Rollouts, newest first (circuit breaker outcomes included)

post.summary: Move a node's tasks elsewhere (replacements start first) and stop new placements. Undo with setNodeSchedulable true.
Run a command once with the service's task definition (e.g. a migration)

get.summary: Jobs in an environment
A job with its next and last run

delete.summary: Delete a job and its run history

get.summary: Runs of a job, newest first

post.summary: Run a job now, optionally with another command

get.summary: Every job in the cluster
One job run (its logs: GET /logs?task={id})

post.summary: Stop an active run

get.summary: Health of every service: state, reason, uptime (24h/7d/30d), last end-to-end check, open incident
Incidents, newest first
Registry host and how to log in and push
Repositories in the private registry
Tags of a repository with digest, size, platforms and creation time, newest first

delete.summary: Delete a tag's manifest (tags sharing the digest go with it)

accessKey.name: Authorization
accessKey.description: SYN1-HMAC-SHA256 Credential=<access key id>, Signature=<hex>, with X-Syn-Date and X-Syn-Content-Sha256 headers

recoveryKeySuffix.description: Last 6 characters of the recovery key printed at install (required when status.recoveryConfirmRequired)

secretAccessKey.description: Only present in the create response

token.description: Only present in the create response

csr.description: PEM certificate signing request for the node's own key

gatewayAddress.description: host:port of the agent gateway (gRPC, mTLS)

token.description: Only present in the create response

targets.description: node IDs, or ["*"] for all nodes (default)

vip.description: stable virtual IP inside the private network (§8.6)
